pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty ALERT - P1 - 11/02 03:14 UTC - service=inference-api - symptom: elevated 5xxs on /v1/chat and route-specific failures on /v1/rerank + degraded embeddings throughput. Incident INC-20261102-9001

Rae K: I'm on the page. Edge is returning a mix of 502/504 for chat; rerank latency spiking and embedding p95 climbing. Traces show chat batcher waiting on rerank calls. :worried:

Diego F: No deploys in last 90m. Telemetry points to a small group of API keys issuing dense chat->rerank->embed pipelines, causing memory pressure in rerank workers and backpressure into batcher.

Marta V: Quick mitigation plan: 1) set per-endpoint per-tier quotas (chat higher RPS than embeddings) 2) circuit-break /v1/rerank for non-enterprise 3) per-org token caps for noisy keys 4) route-specific token-weighting so embeddings count less 5) fallback model for standard chat. Vote?

Luke P: +1. Also propose a soft-queue slowpath for embeddings to return 202 when token-cap hit so clients get deterministic behavior.

infra-bot: detected: rerank-worker-12 OOM @03:12:41 UTC; restart-loop count=5.

Rae K: Execute mitigations. Please paste redwoodctl timestamps when done. I'll draft customer note and update PagerDuty.

Diego F: Applying emergency quotas now. Commands below and timestamps as applied:

```bash
# per-tier quotas
redwoodctl quotas set --route /v1/chat --tier standard --requests-per-minute 120
redwoodctl quotas set --route /v1/embeddings --tier standard --tokens-per-minute 7000

# circuit-break rerank for non-enterprise (429 + Retry-After)
redwoodctl route override --route /v1/rerank --tiers standard,dev --enabled false --status 429 --headers '{"Retry-After":"60"}' --body '{"error":"Rerank temporarily unavailable for non-enterprise"}'

# per-route token-weighting to deprioritize embeddings
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --route /v1/embeddings --weight 0.25
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --route /v1/chat --weight 1.0

# soft slowpath for embeddings (202 queued)
redwoodctl route set-slowpath --route /v1/embeddings --tier standard --enabled true --response-status 202 --response-body '{"status":"queued","eta_seconds":30}'

# per-org token cap example for noisy key
redwoodctl quotas set --route /v1/embeddings --org org-barracuda --tokens-per-minute 1800
redwoodctl quotas set --route /v1/chat --org org-barracuda --requests-per-minute 20

# fallback chat model for standard tier
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/chat --tier standard --model gptx-4-lite

# optional global chat token cap
redwoodctl traffic set-global-token-cap --route /v1/chat --cap 60000/min
```

Diego F: Applied chat quota 03:18:02 UTC, embeddings quota 03:18:06 UTC.

ops-bot: action-log: quotas.update by Diego F @03:18:02 UTC; quotas.update by Diego F @03:18:06 UTC

Diego F: Rerank override (standard/dev) applied 03:18:30 UTC. Token weights set 03:18:50 UTC. Embeddings slowpath enabled 03:19:12 UTC. Per-org caps for org-barracuda applied 03:19:40 UTC. Routing fallback set 03:20:05 UTC. Global chat token cap applied 03:20:30 UTC.

infra-bot: action-log: route.override Diego F @03:18:30 UTC; traffic.update Diego F @03:18:50 UTC; route.slowpath Diego F @03:19:12 UTC; quotas.update Diego F @03:19:40 UTC; routing.update Diego F @03:20:05 UTC; traffic.update Diego F @03:20:30 UTC

Marta V: Observability: within 90s of mitigations chat 5xxs down ~62%; embeddings error-rate down ~35%; rerank requests from standard tier dropped to near zero. Batcher depth decreasing.

Rae K: Customer impact quick estimate: initial list shows ~10 tenants experienced degraded chat UX, 3 tenants had timeouts. Enterprise tenants on dedicated pools unaffected. I'll prepare status page language and targeted notice for affected customers.

Luke P: Added extra protective measure: per-route low-priority queue for embeddings so they don't evict chat (applied 03:21:10 UTC):

{"route":"/v1/embeddings","priority":"low","max_inflight":40}

Luke P: Also applied a token-refill smoothing for embeddings (refill 900 tokens/sec bucket 12000) 03:21:35 UTC.

Diego F: infra-bot reports rerank-worker restart count decreasing; memory stable for 6m after mitigations. No further OOMs observed.

infra-bot: telemetry snapshot: rerank restarts reduced; batcher queue depth normalized.

Marta V: Handoff: Rae I need to step out in 40m. Diego, can you own monitoring and postmortem kickoff? Include noisy keys and redwoodctl commands in the PM.

Diego F: Taking ownership at 03:22 UTC. I'll monitor metrics and coordinate infra scaling if backlog reappears. Plan canary: re-enable rerank for a single standard test org after 25m of stable OOM-free metrics, monitor 5m, then expand to 5 orgs.

Rae K: Handing off to Diego. Updating PagerDuty & CS. PagerDuty note: handoff logged and ticket INC-20261102-9001-PM created and assigned Rae/Diego/Marta.

support-bot: Support update: templated message queued to affected tenants at 03:24 UTC, CS prepared to triage escalations.

Diego F: Quick safety: confirm internal/dev keys exempted from these quotas so CI and canaries not impacted. Confirmed 03:24:50 UTC.

Marta V: Suggest follow-ups for PM: add automated detector for 'chat+rerank combo' token storms to auto-trigger emergency runbook; expose per-route emergency throttle button in Console; make per-org token caps editable in UI; enforce memory caps/fail-fast on legacy rerank worker.

infra-bot: suggestion: consider scaling rerank-dedicated +1 GPU if backlog grows, current utilization 78%.

Diego F: Noted. I'll only scale if backlog rises above threshold or OOMs resume. Right now metrics look stable: chat p95 -> 320ms, p50 -> 90ms; embeddings queued ~4% as 202 responses.

Rae K: Great run. Diego, keep thread updated every 10m. We'll close mitigation after 60m stable or after canary completes successfully. Postmortem to include exact token counts per offending key and decision timeline.

Diego F: Will do. Starting monitor loop. Canine plan scheduled at 03:47 UTC if metrics remain healthy.

support-bot: incident state: mitigated (monitoring). Assigned to Diego F @03:22 UTC.

Marta V: Leaving one caution: check logs for clients that retry on 503/202 aggressively; those can amplify the storm. Add that to PM.

Diego F: Good call. Adding retry-loop detectors to PM tasks. Will report canary result here.

ops-bot: incident.update: handoff logged; mitigation actions recorded in audit.

Diego F: 03:37 UTC update: metrics remain stable, no OOMs for 15m. Canary proceeding at 03:47 UTC as planned.
